answer_1.quote: To assess the quality of LLM-generated explanations for Arabic poetry...

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we compute BLEU and chrF(++) scores... we employ BERTScore... we incorporate Textual Entailment (TE) analysis using mDeBERTaV3...

answer_3.quote: Based on human-annotated interpretive depth scores... GPT-4o demonstrated the strongest performance... thereby motivating its adoption as the LLM-as-judge. In this role, it evaluates explanation quality across two key dimensions: Faithfulness/Consistency... and Fluency/Grammaticality...

answer_4.quote: Three native Arabic speakers with expertise in Arabic literature and linguistics voluntarily applied the evaluation rubric... Literal Comprehension (0-1)... Thematic and Emotional Depth (0-2)... Cultural and Historical Appropriateness (0-2)... Stylistic Sensitivity (0-3)... Expressiveness and Coherence (0-2)...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators used a rubric-based scale (0-10) grounded in poetic analysis.
